Routines

top source red_rotate

SST pipeline

result = red_rotate(array, direction [, /inverse] [, dir=integer])

Wrapper for IDL's rotate() function, adding an inverse flag. Also handling image cubes.

Return value

Returns the rotated and/or transposed image(s).

Parameters

array in type=array

The image to be rotated. For arrays with more than two dimensions, the first two dimensions will be rotated.

direction in type=integer default=0

Defines the operation to be performed, see documentation for rotate(). If negative, the inverse operation is performed.

Keywords

inverse in optional type=boolean

Do the inverse operation. Note: if direction is negative and the inverse keyword is set, this is equivalent to calling with abs(direction) and not setting inverse.

dir out optional type=integer

The value of direction that would give the same operation without /inverse.
